transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer care, my name is Rebecca. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Rebecca. I am calling because I noticed a monthly charge of three pounds fifty for paper billing on my statement. I am registered partially sighted with macular degeneration and cannot read online bills on a screen, so charging me extra for a paper bill feels deeply unfair and upsetting.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can review the billing charges on your account, Fatima. First let me complete account security. Can you verify your full name and billing address?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Fatima Al-Mansoor, 18 Oakwood Drive, Leeds, LS8 2AY.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what is the four-digit security PIN on the account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Fatima, verification is complete. So what I understand is you have a visual impairment and rely on physical paper bills, and you would like us to exempt your account from the three pounds fifty monthly paper invoice charge under our accessibility policy, is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, exactly. My ophthalmologist registered me two years ago, and I need large print paper bills to manage my finances independently.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Are you currently registered on our S-Net Priority Services Register?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, nobody ever mentioned a priority register when I set up the broadband contract last winter.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our standard terms apply the three pounds fifty fee automatically to encourage paperless billing, but customers with verified accessibility needs are fully exempt.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I've been paying this extra fee for six months without realizing it! It really frustrates me that disabled customers are penalised unless they know to complain!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The fee is applied automatically by the computer billing engine unless an accessibility flag is toggled on the profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Well, I would like that flag toggled on immediately, and the past charges refunded.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously I have to open the accessibility compliance ledger to enroll you on the Priority Services Register.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please do, I have my Certificate of Vision Impairment reference number if you need it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What is that reference number, Fatima?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It is CVI slash 88291 slash Leeds.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Bear with me for a moment while I enroll your account on the Priority Services Register.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, Fatima. I have registered your account on the Priority Services Register under visual accessibility.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does that mean my bills will automatically arrive in large print format?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, your future statements will be printed in sixteen-point high-contrast font on non-glare cream paper.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will make such a wonderful difference. I won't have to wait for my daughter to visit to read the bill.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now let me handle the billing charges. Bear with me while I calculate the historical paper billing fees.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks for bearing with me, Fatima. I can see six consecutive charges of three pounds fifty dating back to May, totaling twenty-one pounds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can that twenty-one pounds be credited back to my account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have just processed a credit adjustment of twenty-one pounds to your account balance, which will offset your next monthly direct debit.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And will the three pounds fifty charge appear on next month's bill?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Would you also like to designate a secondary trusted nominee, such as a family member, who can discuss billing details on your behalf?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, my daughter Nadia Al-Mansoor helps me with administrative paperwork occasionally.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What is Nadia's date of birth and contact number so I can add her as an authorized third-party nominee?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Her date of birth is fourteenth of July nineteen ninety, and her mobile is 07700 900214.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have added Nadia as an authorized nominee on your profile. She will be able to speak with our support teams if you are ever unwell.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is such a thoughtful service to offer. It takes a huge worry off my shoulders.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We also offer audio CD and braille billing formats if your visual needs ever change in the future.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Large print works best for me right now with my magnifying glass, but good to know braille is an option.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No, the accessibility exemption permanently suppresses the paper billing surcharge for the duration of your contract.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is fantastic news. What about during power cuts? Does priority service help if my phone or internet drops?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, being on the Priority Services Register entitles you to free priority fault restoration, advance notification of planned network works, and a password-protected door engineer scheme.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The password scheme sounds very reassuring, especially with so many bogus caller scams nowadays.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm the CVI reference for our compliance records, that was CVI slash 88291 slash Leeds, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And would you like your annual terms and conditions notices sent in large print format as well, Fatima?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes please, all written communications in large print if possible.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have ticked the master large print flag across all billing, marketing, and legal correspondence.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you send a letter confirming the twenty-one pound credit and the priority registration?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am dispatching a confirmation letter today in large print format, which should arrive within three working days.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you confirm the current account balance after applying that credit?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your current balance is minus twenty-one pounds, meaning your November invoice of twenty-eight pounds will only deduct seven pounds from your bank.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is crystal clear, and I can see the credit on my telephone banking app already! Everything has been resolved so thoroughly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm your contact telephone number on file, it's 0113 496 0281, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's my home landline.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else with your bills or accessibility services that I can help you with today, Fatima?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No Rebecca, you've been so thorough and helpful in sorting both the refund and the large print format. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It was my absolute pleasure. Thank you for choosing S-Net, Fatima, and have a lovely day.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Rebecca, you too. Goodbye.
